content: JWT cross-service validation pitfalls: (1) algorithm confusion - never trust alg header; pin allowlist (Spring: jws-algorithms=HS256); reject alg=none. (2) HS256 shared secret means every holder can mint tokens - fine when issuer+validator are the only holders, secret >=256 bits from CSPRNG, never a password/string. (3) Clock skew: 30-60s leeway both sides; Spring Security nimbus default 60s; root fix NTP; intermittent 'token not yet valid'/'expired' = skew symptom; do NOT fix by extending token TTL. (4) Validate iss/aud explicitly (custom OAuth2TokenValidator for aud). OWASP JWT cheat sheet: different secret per (issuer,audience) pair; >=160 bits entropy.
